meta.note: Historical rural survey. Agricultural-household measures exclude wage-only households; land/livestock tables also include all/non-agricultural rural households where labelled. Annual and half-year season/visit references remain separate dimensions; the shared endpoint is an indexing date, not a universal observation date. Means may condition on activity/reporting. Source zeros retained; dashes and unresolved parenthesised cells null, with original value attached. All observed cross-tabs retained; no Cartesian expansion or state averaging. MSP category labels have known API defects. Tables 18, 19, 34, 36 and 39 carry corrected API labels (household classification swap, Himachal Pradesh social groups, leasing-in, cattle and buffalo in milk, visit-1 season), each proven against the printed report; original API labels are in each series note.
